system.description:
Fighter, Ranger, Paladin, or Cleric only. Marked with Grabthar's rune (an eye within a diamond; 75% chance any dwarf recognizes it). Both gauntlets must be worn together to function.

  • Grants Strength 18 (+3 to hit, +7 damage with melee or hurled weapons) and +100 lbs carrying capacity.
  • Resonance: Runes glow pale blue when paired with Grabthar's Hammer, stacking bonuses for a combined +5 to hit / +10 damage.
